side.description: The side/direction the marquee scrolls towards.

speed.description: The speed of the marquee animation in pixels per second.

delay.description: The delay before the animation starts (in seconds).

loop-count.description: The number of times to loop the animation (0 = infinite).

auto-fill.description: Whether to automatically duplicate content to fill the container.

pause-on-interaction.description: Whether to pause the marquee on user interaction (hover, focus).

reverse.description: Whether to reverse the animation direction.

default-paused.description: Whether the marquee is paused by default.

as-child.description: Apply the props to the first child element instead of this element.

debug.description: Log state transitions, events and prop changes to the console. Applies to descendants too.

pausechange.description: Fired when the pause status changes.

loopcomplete.description: Fired when the marquee completes one loop iteration.

complete.description:
Fired when the marquee completes all loops and stops.
Only fires for finite loops (loopCount > 0).

ids.description: The ids of the elements in the marquee. Useful for composition.

state.description: The root's state from its machine (`getRootState()`), such as `open` or `disabled`. `undefined` until it connects.

ready.description: Resolves once the element's machine has started, so `api`, state and parts are in place.

api.description: The Zag API of the component. `undefined` until it connects.

restart.description: Restart the marquee animation from the beginning.

as-child.description: Apply the props to the first child element instead of this element.

for.description: The id of the root this part belongs to, when it is not a descendant.

state.description: The part's state from its machine, such as an item's `selected` and `highlighted`. `undefined` until it connects.
